title: Educational & Child Psychology and working in Education Settings with Dr Michele McDowell

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还赚到更多钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和经常性收入渠道。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息，请查看简介中链接我的福利页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正准备成为一名心理学家，那么让这本书成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, let's decide to be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 通过这个播客，让我们决定踏上《有志心理学家播客》的旅程。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening and thank you again for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的收听，也再次感谢你们成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Thank you also to everybody who has been in contact to say how useful they have found the Clinical Psychologist Collective book
sentences.zh: 同时也要感谢所有联系我并表示《临床心理学家合集》这本书非常有帮助的人，

sentences.en: and, of course, the Aspiring Psychologist membership in supporting their application process in psychology this year.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有《有志心理学家》会员群，它们在今年为大家的心理学申请流程提供了支持。

sentences.en: And there have been a few success stories as well within the membership of people getting on to clinical training
sentences.zh: 会员群里也传出了一些成功的好消息，有人成功进入了临床培训，

sentences.en: and also people who found reading the Clinical Psychologist Collective book really helpful in helping them develop their own confidence in talking about their narratives
sentences.zh: 还有人发现阅读《临床心理学家合集》对帮助他们建立谈论自身经历的信心真的很有帮助，

sentences.en: and in reflecting and in reflecting and being able to draw on strengths and experiences across their career.
sentences.zh: 并且在反思以及能够汲取整个职业生涯中的优势和经验方面获益匪浅。

sentences.en: So if you haven't grabbed a copy yet or if you're not yet on the waiting list for the Aspiring Psychologist membership,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你还没有入手一本，或者你还没有加入《有志心理学家》会员群的等待名单，

sentences.en: then do check out the details in the show notes so that you can go and check it all out on my link tree.
sentences.zh: 那么一定要查看节目说明中的详情，这样你就可以去我的Linktree上查看所有内容了。

sentences.en: But with no further ado, whilst we're talking about the Clinical Psychologist Collective,
sentences.zh: 话不多说，既然我们正在谈论《临床心理学家合集》，

sentences.en: why not meet someone who is featured in the book, but not in the capacity of clinical psychology?
sentences.zh: 为什么不认识一位被收录在书中、但身份并非临床心理学家的人呢？

sentences.en: Let's think about other routes to professional qualifications in psychology.
sentences.zh: 让我们来思考一下通往心理学专业资格的其他途径。

sentences.en: In today's podcast episode, I am joined by Dr. Michelle McDowell, who is an educational and child psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在今天的播客节目中，和我一起做客的是米歇尔·麦克道尔博士，她是一位教育与儿童心理学家。

sentences.en: She's lovely to chat to, and I hope you'll find this episode super useful.
sentences.zh: 和她聊天非常愉快，希望你们会觉得这一期节目超级有用。

sentences.en: I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们节目后半部分见。

sentences.en: Okay, welcome along.
sentences.zh: 好的，欢迎收听。

sentences.en: I am joined today by my wonderful guest, Dr. Michelle McDowell.
sentences.zh: 今天和我在一起的是我非常棒的嘉宾米歇尔·麦克道尔博士。

sentences.en: Michelle is an educational psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔是一位教育心理学家。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along, Michelle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎做客，米歇尔。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来，玛丽安。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: So what I think can be really useful is if we give the audience a flavour of where you're at right now, but also a little bit of a potted history about how you got there and why.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果能让观众对你目前的状态有一个初步了解，并大致回顾一下你是如何走到这一步的以及原因，这会非常有用。

sentences.en: Okay, I'll try to remember and recall all of that all in one.
sentences.zh: 好的，我尽量把这些都一口气回忆起来。

sentences.en: So like you said, Marianne, I'm an educational and child psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，玛丽安，我是一名教育与儿童心理学家。

sentences.en: I didn't go directly to that route, and I'll tell you why.
sentences.zh: 我并不是直接走上这条路的，我来告诉你原因。

sentences.en: When I first trained many years ago now, so in 2000, I trained as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 很多年前当我最初接受培训时，也就是在2000年，我接受了心理学家培训。

sentences.en: You had to be a teacher first, so I did my teach training, and by the way, before I did teach training, I had no clue of what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 当时你必须先成为一名老师，所以我参加了教师培训。顺便说一句，在我参加教师培训之前，我根本不知道自己想做什么。

sentences.en: And so somebody was saying to me, oh, you know, the PGCE is one year, and at the time, it was very well funded.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有人对我说，哦，你知道的，PGCE（教育研究生证书）只需一年，而且当时资金很充足。

sentences.en: So I was like, right, okay, that sounds great.
sentences.zh: 于是我想，好吧，听起来不错。

sentences.en: So I did the PGCE for the year and was trained to teach government and politics and history, although I had aspects of psychology within my initial degree.
sentences.zh: 所以我读了一年的PGCE，接受了教授政府、政治和历史的培训，尽管我的本科初级学位中包含一些心理学方面的课程。

sentences.en: So I went along to teach training, after that, started on my teaching career in secondary school, and in my very, very first term, I was a full tutor, right?
sentences.zh: 接着我去参加了教师培训，在那之后，我在一所中学开始了我的教学生涯。在我的第一学期，真的就是第一学期，我是一名全职导师。

sentences.en: In my very first term of teaching, I had a pupil who was a lovely young man in year seven, never forget him.
sentences.zh: 在我教书的第一个学期，我有一个七年级的学生，是个可爱的男孩子，我永远不会忘记他。

sentences.en: And he was, you know, just really sporty, actually, and just a joyous young man, really bubbly in the class, struggled of literacy, just couldn't get to engage with literacy.
sentences.zh: 他其实很有运动天赋，是一个快乐的阳光男孩，在班上非常活泼，但阅读能力有些吃力，就是无法投入到阅读中。

sentences.en: And quite a few of his teachers at secondary school, obviously, so, you know, would comment and say, he's got all the answers, but it's really struggling.
sentences.zh: 中学里的好几位老师自然也会评论说，他什么都懂，但真的很吃力。

sentences.en: So the SENCO, I had to do a discussion with a special educational needs coordinator, the SENCO, and she'd organised for the educational psychologist to come into school.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不与特殊教育需求统筹员（SENCO）进行沟通，她已经安排了教育心理学家来学校。

sentences.en: And during the consultation, I said to her, can you tell me what exactly is it that you do?
sentences.zh: 在咨询期间，我对她说，你能告诉我你到底是做什么的吗？

sentences.en: And after an elongated conversation, I had my aha moment, and that was it.
sentences.zh: 经过一番长谈，我迎来了我的“醍醐灌顶”时刻，就是这样。

sentences.en: I was like, this is my calling.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，这就是我的使命。

sentences.en: This is what I'm supposed to do, educational psychology.
sentences.zh: 这就是我应该做的事，教育心理学。

sentences.en: So I then continued on the journey.
sentences.zh: 于是我便继续踏上了这段旅程。

sentences.en: Now, I want to make a distinction because it's very different now, but my journey through to the training to become an educational psychologist, like I said at the beginning,
sentences.zh: 现在，我想做一个区分，因为现在的情况非常不同，但我成为教育心理学家的培训之路，正如我在开始时所说，

sentences.en: was you needed some teaching experience.
sentences.zh: 你需要具备一些教学经验。

sentences.en: So I'd already started on that journey.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经踏上了那段旅程。

sentences.en: I had a degree that had some aspects of psychology in it, but not enough to get the GBR status.
sentences.zh: 我有一个包含一些心理学内容的学位，但还不足以获得GBR（特许资格基础）身份。

sentences.en: So I then had to do an initial master's in psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不先攻读一个心理学硕士学位。

sentences.en: And then it wasn't quite a diploma, but I guess it was a certificate in the additional topics that you needed to become a, to get that GBR status.
sentences.zh: 然后，它虽然算不上是一个文凭，但我想它是一张证明你掌握了成为心理学家并获得GBR身份所需额外主题的证书。

sentences.en: And then I applied to be an educational psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 接着我申请成为一名教育心理学家。

sentences.en: Now that sounds like quite a simple route, but it took years.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能是一条相当简单的路线，但它花了好几年时间。

sentences.en: So I was studying part-time.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在进行兼职学习。

sentences.en: I'm going on and on here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里说个没完没了了。

sentences.en: Do you want me to continue?
sentences.zh: 你想让我继续吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: How old were you when you started your, when you started your education?
sentences.zh: 你开始接受教育时多大年纪？

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: What a question.
sentences.zh: 这是什么问题呀。

sentences.en: What a question.
sentences.zh: 这算什么问题。

sentences.en: Does that feel okay to ask you that question?
sentences.zh: 问你这个问题感觉合适吗？

sentences.en: Of course, of course, I'm confident in my womanhood and agehood, as they say.
sentences.zh: 当然，当然，正如他们所说，我对自己的女性身份和年龄充满自信。

sentences.en: I, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我，我不知道。

sentences.en: Let me think now.
sentences.zh: 让我想想。

sentences.en: Because I did my doctorate later.
sentences.zh: 因为我后来才攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: So actually, let me carry on with the journey.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，让我继续讲讲这段旅程吧。

sentences.en: So when I trained, you needed a master in science, the MSc, to become an educational child psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 当年我受训时，你需要拥有理学硕士学位（MSc）才能成为一名教育与儿童心理学家。

sentences.en: And it was many moons ago.
sentences.zh: 那是很多年前的事了。

sentences.en: So, um, so I think I did the MA and then the MSc.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我想我先读了文学硕士（MA），然后是理学硕士（MSc）。

sentences.en: And I think by the time 2000, how old would I have been?
sentences.zh: 我想到了2000年的时候，我该多大年纪了？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was fully qualified.
sentences.zh: 对，我已经完全具备资格了。

sentences.en: You were not hanging around, were you?
sentences.zh: 你可真是一点也没闲着，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you did your teaching qualification.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了教师资格证。

sentences.en: And you did all of the stuff you needed to do to be able to qualify as an ed psych at 30.
sentences.zh: 你在30岁时就完成了成为一名教育心理学家所需的所有工作。

sentences.en: That's some going.
sentences.zh: 这真是一项了不起的成就。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, to be honest, I spent much longer in teaching because I loved it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我在教学岗位上呆的时间要长得多，因为我热爱教学。

sentences.en: So there was a much, there was quite a bit of, do I go?
sentences.zh: 所以当时有过很多纠结，我是该走呢？

sentences.en: Do I not go?
sentences.zh: 还是不走呢？

sentences.en: Because I really, really enjoy teaching.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的非常非常喜欢教学。

sentences.en: Um, but it was changing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但情况正在发生变化。

sentences.en: And it was at that stage that we, they were making adjustments in the curriculum again.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个阶段，他们又在对课程进行调整。

sentences.en: And it was much more sort of paper-based.
sentences.zh: 而且更多的是基于纸质文书的工作。

sentences.en: And I was like, it's probably a good time to, you know, transfer and change, really.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，这可能真的是个转型和改变的好时机。

sentences.en: And so I chose to do it then, yeah, in 2000.
sentences.zh: 所以我就在那时做出了选择，对，在2000年。

sentences.en: I love that actually it was a personal story, a personal connection, something that you could
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个故事，它是一个个人的故事、个人的联系，正是某种你几乎可以

sentences.en: tangibly almost feel and connect to that really turned your head in the direction of educational psychology.
sentences.zh: 切实感受到并与之产生共鸣的东西，真正引领你走向了教育心理学方向。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think it is, oh, it's my, one of my favourite things about this profession
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为这确实是，这也是我从事的心理学这个职业中最喜欢的几个方面之一，

sentences.en: of psychology of ours is that we get to work with people, you know, who can shape us as well as, um, hopefully we have a positive impact on them as well.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们能够与这样的人共事，他们既能塑造我们，而希望我们也能对他们产生积极的影响。

sentences.en: But that young man might never know, you know, that actually, the impact he had on you.
sentences.zh: 但那个年轻男孩可能永远不会知道，实际上，他曾对你产生过这样的影响。

sentences.en: And it's really incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真的很不可思议。

sentences.en: Um, but I'm really pleased it happened because it, it did, you know, lead you towards this new passion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我很高兴这件事发生了，因为它确实，你知道的，引领你走向了这个新的热情所在。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I, and I think if we, if I think about my life, actually, there have been these significant
sentences.zh: 我，而且我认为如果回想我的人生，实际上确实有过这些重大的时刻，

sentences.en: moments as I'm sure it is for everybody else, um, and often personal that have been impacted
sentences.zh: 我相信对其他人来说也是如此，嗯，而且往往是受到个人经历的影响和触发，从而迈向新的领域，

sentences.en: and triggered moving on to something new, you know, um, or certainly a change in transition.
sentences.zh: 嗯，或者肯定经历了一场转变或过渡。

sentences.en: So yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It's important that we can reflect on that, can't we?
sentences.zh: 我们能够对此进行反思，这一点很重要，对吧？

sentences.en: Have you ever done any, you know, journaling or diary kind of keeping to help you with your reflections or how do you manage your reflections if you don't do that?
sentences.zh: 你有没有做过任何，你知道的，写日志或记日记来帮助你进行反思，或者如果你不这样做，你是如何管理你的反思的？

sentences.en: Do you know, it's really interesting, you know, because I used to journal quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，这真的很有趣，你知道的，因为我过去经常写日记。

sentences.en: Um, I used to write poetry actually.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我以前还经常写诗。

sentences.en: And then I, I, I used to journal almost, I think daily for years and years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 然后我，我，我几乎每天都写日记，连续写了多年又多年。

sentences.en: Um, and, um, after I had my son, so about, um, well, about 10 years ago now, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，在我生完儿子之后，大约，嗯，差不多就是10年前吧？

sentences.en: I, um, paused and then just kind of, I've done it intermittently, but not quite ever got consistently back into it.
sentences.zh: 我，嗯，暂停了，然后就只是，偶尔会写一点，但再也没有真正坚持恢复到以前的频率。

sentences.en: And I miss it.
sentences.zh: 我很想念它。

sentences.en: And so I think maybe I'm going to start again.
sentences.zh: 所以我想也许我要重新开始了。

sentences.en: Stop journaling again, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想我又要开始写日记了。

sentences.en: It's never too long to start again, is it?
sentences.zh: 重新开始永远不会太晚，对吧？

sentences.en: But, you know, it's recognising the stuff that's been useful along our journey.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我们要认识到在我们的旅程中有用的东西。

sentences.en: Um, and then thinking, oh, I might, I might do that again, you know?
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后心想，哦，我可能，我可能还会那样做，你知道吗？

sentences.en: What, what form did you used to do it?
sentences.zh: 你以前是用什么形式来写的？

sentences.en: Did you do it kind of at the end of your day?
sentences.zh: 你是在一天的结束时写吗？

sentences.en: Would you do it at the beginning of the day or a little bit of, you know, ad hoc, um, here and there?
sentences.zh: 你是在一天开始的时候写，还是零星地，你知道的，随兴而写？

sentences.en: I think there were phases.
sentences.zh: 我想这是分阶段的。

sentences.en: So I think when I was much younger, I used to do it at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 所以我想当我年轻得多的时候，我习惯在一天结束时写。

sentences.en: And it used to be almost a kind of, um, a reflection on what, what I'd experienced each day.
sentences.zh: 它几乎成了一种，嗯，对每天所经历的事情的反思。

sentences.en: And then I think sort of post degree around that time, it used to be something that I did quite early on in the morning and it was more intentional.
sentences.zh: 然后我想大概在毕业后的一段时间里，它成了我一大早就会做的事情，而且更有目的性。

sentences.en: So I used to focus on what I wanted the day to look like and it was much more focused.
sentences.zh: 所以我过去常常专注于我希望这一天是什么样子，而且更有重点。

sentences.en: And then I went through a period of time that was very intentional and I got into the, um,
sentences.zh: 然后我经历了一段非常有目的性的时期，我开始接触，嗯，
